name: btc_fb_square_variations
description: 9 Facebook 1:1 silver ad creatives — navy backdrop, even studio light

approved_style.background: deep midnight navy blue matte seamless studio backdrop
approved_style.lighting: even balanced studio lighting, large softboxes left and right, catalog clarity
approved_style.contrast_note: navy must contrast clearly with cool silver products so metal pops in feed

variations.label: Ingot standalone — Egypt 100g hero
variations.composition: Single rectangular silver ingot centered upright on navy, generous negative space top for ad copy. Product fills lower two-thirds.

variations.label: Ingot trio — Egypt, Mother, BTC
variations.composition: Three ingot bars in confident triangular flat-lay, Egypt front center, Mother back left, BTC back right.

variations.label: Coin standalone — Sobhan Allah 10g
variations.composition: Single round silver coin centered, slight angle showing relief depth, hero product on navy.

variations.label: Coin trio — three religious 10g coins
variations.composition: Three round 10g religious phrase silver coins arranged in triangle on navy, equal hero treatment, crisp relief detail.
variations.note: Disney character coin refs blocked by KIE safety; trio uses religious line only

variations.label: Bar standalone — 1kg cast bar
variations.composition: Single large cast silver bar angled 15 degrees, dominant weight in frame, investment-grade hero on navy.

variations.label: Mixed — coin + ingot + bar
variations.composition: One round coin left, one rectangular ingot center, one cast bar right — balanced trio showing full BTC silver range, scale proportional to references.

variations.label: Mixed — ingot + bar
variations.composition: Egypt ingot and 500g cast bar side by side, ingot slightly forward, bar receding — two-format investment story.

variations.label: Mixed — Allah Akbar coin + 500g bar
variations.composition: 10g round religious phrase silver coin foreground left, 500g cast bar background right, heritage gift meets investment on navy.
variations.note: Licensed character coin refs blocked by KIE safety; use religious coin here

variations.label: Mixed — religious coin + ingot
variations.composition: Sobhan Allah coin lower left, Egypt ingot upper right, diagonal balance, gift and heritage pairing.
